role: Nether and End spawn-area dump: loads the 625 chunks around the dimension's spawn point through that dimension's ChunkProviderServer in initialWorldChunkLoad order, on its own thread bound to Det's SERVER role, and writes a Snapshot-format directory plus animals.jsonl: the reference for seedworld_init_dim.
used_by: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Main.java --spawndumpdim DIM:DIR (called from Oracle.preTick at tick 0)
make -C oracle run CLASS=SpawnDumpDim (the generic {"cmd":"run","class":"SpawnDumpDim"} reflection dispatch in Oracle.java)
notes: Manifest carries both the dimension spawn (0, avg ground, 0) and the overworld spawn DerivedWorldInfo reports. No oracle/src hook.
